description: HushPinterest v0.0.4: 20 patches for Pinterest 14.38.0, and the same set for 14.25.0 on Android 9. New in this release: Hide save toasts, Original-quality images, a Hide Search button switch, Copy media link, Set as wallpaper in Download history and Hide advertising ID. Validation: 670 runtime tests passed. All 156 patch tests passed. All 20 patches applied without forcing to Pinterest 14.38.0 and 14.25.0. Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. Uninstall the stock app first, then sign in with your email and a Pinterest password.
